provenance.what: Golden values taken from Mojang's own 1.18.2 server bytecode by reflection. Obfuscated names resolved from the OFFICIAL Mojang server mappings. Nothing here is a reimplementation: every value is what the real game computes.
notes: XoroshiroRandomSource's two long fields (seedLo:a seedHi:b) were identified by experiment; declaration order is [lo, hi] and every seedWords column below is normalised to [lo, hi].
BuiltinRegistries.NOISE was walked: 60 noise parameter sets, 12 of them sampled in depth (Perlin stack and octave origins as well as NormalNoise).
Biome's static PerlinSimplexNoise fields were read directly from the class; octave lists are proved by value, not by memory.
